decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical file access and sharing mode definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS and COMMAND sources include filemode.inc.
DOS DISK uses access_mask, open_for_write and open_for_read; all 1206 bytes of its previously compared contribution match target MSDOS.SYS.
The previously compared OPEN contribution matches all 373 bytes at the target offset (review 095).
limitations: The module comparisons support constants exercised in the selected build, not every declared flag or structure. Final core links and whole-file identity remain unverified.
